english: They put forward, then, a testament directed to the citizens, in which it urges that images not be brought into churches or into the cemeteries.

title: Hold the traditions; keep God in memory, not images
english: Pay attention to yourselves, and hold fast the traditions you received. Do not turn aside to the right or to the left. And in this, beloved children, keep the memory of not bringing images into churches or into the cemeteries of the saints, but always keep God in your hearts through memory.

title: No images even in a common house; anathema on depicting the incarnate Word
english: But not even in an ordinary house. A Christian must not be distracted through the eyes and the wanderings of the mind; rather, the things that pertain to God should be written and impressed upon everyone. If anyone deliberately endeavors to comprehend the divine character of God's Word according to the incarnation from material colors, let him be anathema.
